crossRefs.note: All these servants of yours will come down to me, and bow down themselves to me, saying, “Get out, with all the people…
Yahweh says: “The labor of Egypt, and the merchandise of Ethiopia, and the Sabeans, men of stature, will come over to…
Kings shall be your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers. They will bow down to you with their faces…
The sons of those who afflicted you will come bowing to you; and all those who despised you will bow themselves down at…
I will bear the indignation of Yahweh, because I have sinned against him, until he pleads my case, and executes…
Then my enemy will see it, and shame will cover her who said to me, where is Yahweh your God? Then my enemy will see me…
Behold, I give some of the synagogue of Satan, of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but lie—behold, I will…
Then the king commanded, and they brought Daniel, and cast him into the den of lions. The king spoke and said to…
Then the king was exceedingly glad, and commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den. So Daniel was taken…
Behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged that he would depart from their borders.
They began to beg him to depart from their region.

translations.web: and they came and begged them. When they had brought them out, they asked them to depart from the city.
translations.bsb: They came to appease them and led them out, requesting that they leave the city.
translations.kjv: And they came and besought them, and brought them out, and desired them to depart out of the city.
translations.asv: and they came and besought them; and when they had brought them out, they asked them to go away from the city.
